contract.selection: Development only: prefer negative-file FPR <=5%, highest recall, lowest threshold meeting the budget, then lowest FPR and two-hit confirmation. Provisional sensitivity policy addresses long-file extreme-score bias.

encoder.input_spec: 16 kHz mono float waveform [-1,1]; encoder's own 64-band log-Mel/0.96 s patches, mean of 1024-D patch embeddings per 3 s context
encoder.name: Google YAMNet v1, AudioSet-pretrained MobileNet
encoder.pretraining_overlap: AudioSet/YouTube and public-source overlap not ruled out; external capture independence remains limited

input_gain.scope: available samples in current context, before padding

limitations: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY gain-normalization experiment. No fresh independent assessment; not a replacement for the assessed default model.
normalization: Weighted train-bag windows only; mean/scale stored in NPZ
